description: This file is a C# code-behind class for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named TheorySet. It contains event handlers for page load, button clicks, dropdown selections, and other UI interactions related to managing theory questions and exams in an online examination system. The code interacts with a SQL database to add questions, set exam details, and populate course selections based on semester and year.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class for the ASP.NET Web Forms page 'TheorySet' handling UI events and database interactions for managing questions and exam details.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; currently commented out code for session handling.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester/year.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new theory question into the database, updates question number, and alerts the user.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Adds exam details for a course into the database and redirects to the admin panel.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown items based on selected semester/year.
